purpose: Run the first real-response falsifier of the frozen persistent-time-well causal-memory quadrature on E14 only, with no E18 or circular-control clock response access and no formula retuning.

parser.clk_header_boundary: Read until the single END OF HEADER record. Afterward inspect only the record-type and fixed PRN token; numerically decode only AS E14 rows. Never split or convert the numeric payload of any other PRN row.
parser.clk_value: RINEX CLOCK 2.00 first clock estimate in seconds; standard deviation column is not used.
parser.sp3_value: SP3 dV P-record E14 x,y,z in km; ignore the SP3 clock column.
parser.epoch_grid: For each daily pair, exact equality intersection of E14 CLK and E14 SP3 calendar epochs; no interpolation; exclude the first and last common epoch; form no interval across a daily boundary.
parser.response: For each consecutive retained common-epoch pair within a day, y=(clock_offset[i+1]-clock_offset[i])/(t[i+1]-t[i]) and the source predictor is evaluated at the interval midpoint by endpoint averaging.
parser.missing_or_duplicate_rule: Reject duplicate E14 CLK epochs; retain only exact common epochs; report every missing interval and reject any retained interval whose duration is not 300 s.

physical_template.instantaneous_source: q(t)=-(GM/r(t)+|v_inertial(t)|^2/2)/c^2. SP3 coordinates are Earth-fixed ITRF14, so v_inertial is frozen as the centered 300 s ECEF position difference plus Omega_Earth cross r; the first and last source epochs use one-sided differences but cannot enter retained response intervals.
physical_template.product_correction: ESOC already applied the standard eccentric correction 2 r dot v/c^2. Therefore y is treated as a corrected clock residual and x_tau=psi_tau-q is a residual causal-memory quadrature, not a replacement fit of the ordinary redshift amplitude.
physical_template.state_update: For a=exp(-300/tau), zero-order-hold q over each interval gives psi[i+1]=a psi[i]+(1-a)q[i]. The initial psi is the exact periodic fixed point of the first source-only 155-sample E14 cycle, then propagation is continuous over all seven unique source days with no daily reset.
physical_template.interval_predictor: x_tau[i]=(psi[i]-q[i]+psi[i+1]-q[i+1])/2; standardize once by its source-only population standard deviation over all retained E14 intervals.

nuisance_and_likelihood.day_projection: Before any candidate fit, separately project y and every predictor off an intercept and centered linear trend within each whole day. This identical response-dependent nuisance projection makes the score a conditional/profile leave-one-day-out score, not a fully generative day-ahead probability.
nuisance_and_likelihood.primary_model: Projected y = beta_tau projected(x_tau) + AR(1) innovation.
nuisance_and_likelihood.ar1_fit: On each six-day training set and for each model, alternate exact least squares after a within-day Prais-Winsten transform with pooled lag-one residual estimation; initialize rho=0, clip rho to [-0.995,0.995], stop at 20 iterations or |delta rho|<1e-10, and set innovation variance to transformed training SSE divided by transformed training row count.
nuisance_and_likelihood.heldout_score: Freeze beta, rho, and innovation variance from six days. Apply the same predeclared day projection to the omitted day, then sum the Gaussian AR(1) log likelihood with a stationary first-row factor. Fit no signal, rho, or variance parameter on the omitted day.
nuisance_and_likelihood.folds: Exactly seven leave-one-day-out E14 folds. Select tau once by maximum total alternative-minus-null heldout log likelihood; ties choose smaller tau.
nuisance_and_likelihood.reported_beta: Report standardized beta and physical beta=standardized_beta/source-only predictor standard deviation. The sign gate is at least six of seven training-fold physical betas with the same nonzero sign.

frozen_controls.phase_scramble: At the selected real tau, circularly shift x_tau separately within each day by each of the eight source-frozen sample offsets; rerun the identical seven-fold procedure and retain all scores.
frozen_controls.instantaneous_countermodel: Run the identical seven-fold score with projected standardized q alone.
frozen_controls.free_orbital_phase_countermodel: Run the identical seven-fold score with projected standardized q and its centered finite-difference derivative as two freely fitted columns. Then add x_tau and report its incremental heldout log likelihood. This tests whether memory is merely an orbit-phase/quadrature proxy.
frozen_controls.orbit_control: No epoch-specific SP3 covariance, SLR residual, or orbit-error proxy is supplied in the frozen files; do not impute one. The free orbital-phase countermodel is retained as a degeneracy diagnostic, not a calibrated orbit correction.
frozen_controls.environment_control: Onboard temperature, magnetic field, attitude, clock identity, and solar-radiation-pressure series are absent; record unavailable and do not impute.
frozen_controls.plasma_control: The CLK product is an ionosphere-free combined estimate and has no separate E1/E5a/E5b response; record chromatic/plasma discrimination unavailable.
frozen_controls.circular_control: E25 and E31 identities are frozen source-only, but their clock response rows are forbidden in this package. Their missing test is an explicit promotion blocker, not a passed control.

interesting_observation_gate: selected_tau total E14 conditional heldout delta log likelihood is positive
at least six of seven E14 beta signs agree
real registered score exceeds every frozen phase-scramble score
memory adds positive heldout log likelihood beyond the free orbital-phase countermodel
development_decision.E18_promotion_gate: Always BLOCKED in this package because the two predeclared circular response controls, calibrated orbit/SLR series, and environment series are unopened or unavailable. E18 may not be opened regardless of the E14 score.
development_decision.claim_boundary: A passing E14 pattern is a development observation only. It cannot establish gravity, time wells, chromaticity, mechanism, novelty, or publication readiness.
